posts.raw_content:
...No Jesus, No Peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...

For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain. —Philippians 1:21

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

The first miracle

Now, friends, we were looking at that instance where the Lord turned the water into wine. And we believe that the most important part of that wedding was not the dress the bride wore. But the most important thing there were these six water pots of stone, beaten and battered, not very attractive. And our Lord took them empty. That’s the way He takes you and me; He saves us as sinners. He fills us with the water of the Word—He wants to—and then ladle that out. And when it’s ladled out, it will become the wine of joy. That is the great message that’s in this first miracle which He performed.

References: John 2:12-25 , John 3:1-4

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/the-first-miracle-1296655.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me. (Psalm 138:7)

Fear not the troubled paths of your life. Give no concern to the sundry evils that press in upon you. Give your entire focus to the pursuit of the interests of the heavenly kingdom. Ever will the Shepherd protect His sheep. Ever will the King of all watch over the ways of His subjects. O believer, be not dismayed for neither shall you faint in weariness nor fall to the missiles of the enemy. Trust in Almighty God and proclaim the peace of His hand!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Anchor for the Soul...

“Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the vail;” — Hebrews 6:19

Biblical Hope Does Not Calm the Storm, but It Holds the Soul Through It

https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/anchor-for-the-soul

...C. H. Spurgeon's Evening Reading (October 30th)...

"Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to Thy voice: cause me to hear it." — Song of Songs 8:13

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?Time=pm

...C. H. Spurgeon's Morning Reading (October 31st)...

"Renew a right spirit within me." — Psalm 51:10

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?doy=304





...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=aG5gQZZ3noLTFzQk

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm

“The sin underneath all our sins is to trust the lie of the serpent that we cannot trust the love and grace of Christ and must take matters into our own hands” - Martin Luther

Eyes Forward

Hold The Line Patriots

Keep Calm

And
